finding.description: Asset-size probes followed redirects without revalidating the destination or rescoping preview credentials.
finding.evidence: Local Semgrep crawler-credentials-automatic-redirect rule matched the original assetSize fetch. Before-patch regression reproduced a metadata-address redirect returning a size and a synthetic preview credential reaching a different host. No external targets or real credentials used.
finding.impact: A controlled asset redirect could reach an otherwise blocked host or disclose preview bypass headers to another origin.
finding.recommendation: Use bounded manual redirects, validate each destination, recompute crawlerHeadersFor each host, and share one request deadline.
verification: 2026-10-25: two security regression tests failed on original code; fixed pageSnapshot+seoCheckRun suites passed 13/13.
2026-10-25: targeted local Semgrep rule matched 1 before and 0 after; complete security rules rescan has no original-rule match.

2026-10-26: upstream merge rewrote assetSize with the same bounded manual-redirect, per-hop validation and per-host credentials; pageSnapshot and seoCheckRun redirect/credential regressions passed (seo-checks 62/62).

finding.description: User-authored split-test and release-gate expressions ran on the native backtracking regular-expression engine.
finding.evidence: Official Semgrep detect-non-literal-regexp identified native dynamic matching. A safe isolated Node subprocess testing ^/(a+)+$ against a 34-character path exceeded 2 seconds and was terminated. Input validation previously checked syntax only.
finding.impact: An authorized project operator or repository change could exhaust the CPU budget for a backtest or release check. Length-limiting the pattern alone did not prevent exponential matching.
finding.recommendation: Use RE2JS matching and validate the RE2 feature set at configuration boundaries. Existing patterns using lookaround/backreferences require replacement; stored gate configuration now fails explicitly instead of silently dropping ignores.
verification: 2026-10-25: 1000-character adversarial input completes through public weigh entry point; unsupported backreference syntax is rejected by gate and split-test schemas.
2026-10-25: DB-backed planCheck regression rejects unsupported stored gate config; saved split-test failures use actionable INVALID_PATH_PATTERN client copy.
2026-10-25: focused regression suite 105/105 passed across 22 files. Original native-regex findings in remediated paths absent from final Semgrep rescan.

Compatibility: RE2 matching preserves ordinary path search/anchors but intentionally rejects unsupported constructs. Recreate saved split tests with supported patterns; update relay-gate.json before retrying queued runs.

finding.description: Draft release notes used a predictable global temporary filename and followed pre-existing symlinks.
finding.evidence: CodeQL js/insecure-temporary-file reported the Date.now-based filename. A subprocess regression pre-created a symlink at that predictable name; original CLI overwrote the synthetic victim. Git and gh were local stubs and no release was published.
finding.impact: A different local user able to precreate the guessed temporary path could cause an operator running --draft to overwrite a writable file or alter temporary release-note handling.
finding.recommendation: Create a random private directory, exclusively write the note file with mode 0600, and remove the directory in a finally block.
verification: 2026-10-25: regression failed before patch by observing victim content replaced; passes after with unchanged victim,0700 directory, 0600 file, and cleanup.
2026-10-25: fresh CodeQL database and security-extended rescan no longer reports js/insecure-temporary-file.
